en.headline: Watchdog hardening in sogeisetsu plus a bug report on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-08, sogeisetsu made 4 own commits in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu, plus 8 automated commits by github-actions[bot]. The own commits hardened the watchdog so failures no longer swallow errors and instead throw so Invocations success rate can serve as an alert, added a BOM-stripping fallback for tokens with a note on the secret pitfall, introduced a Cloudflare Worker watchdog as a fallback for the daily report schedule, and adjusted the daily cron to avoid the top of the hour with an added push trigger on this repo. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. On the issues side, sogeisetsu opened issue #4537 in openchamber/openchamber titled "[Bug] OpenCode Go quota shows Provider not configured while the Providers page shows an API key for it" and then commented on it twice more, bringing the day's issue activity to 3 actions on that single issue. A reply was received from openchamber-bot[bot] on #4537, noting the fix-ready status and confirming the two surfaces resolve OpenCode Go credentials differently on current main.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 加固 watchdog，并在 openchamber 提交 bug 报告
zh.summary: 2026-10-08 当天，sogeisetsu 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中提交了 **4 次本人提交**，另有 8 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人提交围绕 watchdog 加固：让失败不再吞错、改为抛异常以便用 Invocations 成功率作为告警；为 token 增加去 BOM 兜底并补充 secret 踩坑记录；新增 Cloudflare Worker watchdog 作为日报调度的兜底；调整 daily cron 避开整点，并加入本仓 push 兜底触发。当天没有 PR、review 或 release。Issue 方面，sogeisetsu 在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开了 #4537《[Bug] OpenCode Go quota shows "Provider not configured" while the Providers page shows an API key for it》，随后又在该 issue 上评论了两次，当天在该 issue 上共有 3 次操作。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 在 #4537 上回复，标记为 `fix-ready`，并确认当前 main 上两个界面解析 OpenCode Go 凭据的方式不一致。
